title: Forbidden Forge
description: A game-changing data pack that introduces ultra-overpowered, custom-crafted armor sets with permanent potion boosts, mythical custom weapons, stackable totems, and game-breaking tools.
body:
⚡ Godlike Armory & Overpowered Custom Gear ⚡

Welcome to the ultimate endgame enhancement for Minecraft 1.21.х! This data pack completely revamps the crafting system, introducing 6 mythical armor sets embedded with permanent potion powers, legendary weapons with forbidden enchantment levels, and highly requested stackable survival utilities.

🛡️ THE 6 MYTHICAL ARMOR SETS (All 4 Pieces Included)

Every single piece of these 6 armor sets comes with maximum custom modifications. Each individual piece is crafted using highly valuable blocks and custom ingredients to unlock permanent, game-breaking potion attributes directly built into the gear!

🟥 1. Netherite Armor Set 

Crafting Material: Every piece is crafted using pure Netherite Ingots (netherite_ingot) instead of regular netherite upgrading.

Enchantments: Protection IV, Unbreaking III, Mending.

Built-in Attributes: Permanent Strength II and Fire Resistance, turning you into an unstoppable juggernaut.

🟨 2. Gold Armor Set

Crafting Material: Crafted using raw Gold Blocks (gold_block) arranged in the vanilla armor shapes

Enchantments: Protection X, Unbreaking V, Mending.

Built-in Attributes: Giving gold blocks and xp farming (just download it).

🟦 3. Leather Armor Set 

Crafting Material: Crafted using Coal  items arranged in the vanilla armor shapes

Enchantments: Protection IV, Unbreaking III, Mending.

Built-in Attributes: Permanent Speed V and Jump Boost ?, providing insane agility on land and through air.

⬜ 4. Iron Armor Set

Crafting Material: Crafted entirely out of Iron Bars (iron_bars) arranged in the vanilla armor shapes.

Enchantments: Protection IV, Unbreaking III, Mending.

Built-in Attributes: Enchanting ability, launching ability, trading ability, debris droping when mining iron with a helmet.

🟩 5. Chainmail Armor Set

Crafting Material: Crafted using Iron Nuggets (iron_nugget) arranged in the vanilla armor shapes.

Enchantments: Protection X, Unbreaking V, Mending.

Built-in Attributes: None! Just maxed out armor. It is better than the vanilla diamond one.

💎 6. Diamond Armor Set 

Crafting Material: Crafted using pure Diamond Blocks (diamond_block) arranged in the vanilla armor shapes

Enchantments: Protection IV, Unbreaking III, Mending.

Built-in Attributes: Permanent Dolphin grace and Conduit Power, ensuring you never drop below full health; don't forget to sneak with the diamond boots.

⚔️ MYTHICAL WEAPONS & CUSTOM TOOLS

🔨 Custom Mace: "GG tho!"
Crafting Recipe: Formed using 3 Heavy Cores and 2 Breeze Rods. The top-left, top-right, and absolute center slots contain Heavy Cores, while the top-middle and bottom-middle slots hold Breeze Rods.

Stats: Completely Unbreakable, i think!

Enchantments: Wind Burst III, Density V, and Breach IV. Designed to execute infinite slam-combos and instantly pierce through any opponent's defense.

🔱 Custom Trident: "Вилка" (The Fork)
Crafting Recipe: Crafted with a Heart of the Sea in the absolute center, 2 Diamonds in the top-left and top-right slots, and 3 Breeze Rods placed in the remaining middle vertical/diagonal slots to form an inverted cross.

Stats: Completely Unbreakable.

Enchantments: Riptide III, Sharpness V, Impaling V, and Unbreaking III. Unleashes devastating melee damage while letting you fly through the rain like a rocket.

🗡️ Broken Diamond Sword: "Crazy Diamond Slicer"
Crafting Recipe: 2 Diamond Blocks vertically placed over 1 Stripped Oak Log at the bottom.

Stats: Completely Unbreakable.

Enchantments: Illegal Sharpness XV (15) and Looting XXV (25). One-shots almost any entity while raining down hundreds of items upon kill.

🪓 Custom Pickaxe "Dirty Grind"

 Crafting recipe: Upside down stone pickaxe.
Enchantments: Efficiency X and Fortune X. Instantly deletes blocks and multiplies your mined ores beyond imagination.

🏹 Legendary Bow "Cordial Antante"
Crafting Recipe: Crafted using 3 Oak Logs and 3 White Wool arranged in the classic bow pattern. The wool blocks occupy the entire right vertical column, while the logs form the outer curve on the left and center.
 Stats: Completely Unbreakable

🎯 Mythic Crossbow "Minigun"
Crafting Recipe: Formed with 3 Oak Logs, 2 White Wool Blocks, 1 Iron Block, and 1 Tripwire Hook. Oak logs are placed in the top-left, top-right, and bottom-center. An Iron Block sits at the top-center, Wool Blocks take the middle-left and middle-right, and a Tripwire Hook is positioned in the exact center.
Stats: Completely Unbreakable.

🎒 STACKABLE UTILITIES & FLIGHT

To clean up your inventory and maximize survival efficiency, specific item limits have been broken:

4-Stackable Totems of Undying: Crafted using a Netherite Block in the center, a cross of Diamond Blocks , and Iron Blocks in the 4 corners. Yields 4 stackable totems in a single slot!

16-Stackable OP Potions: Custom Speed and Strength potions modified to stack up to 16 per slot for ultimate inventory management:

Speed Potions (x16 Stack): Crafted using 4 Sugar Cane in the corners, 4 Sugar in the remaining outer edges, and Glass_bottle in the center slot. 

Strength Potions (x16 Stack): Crafted using 4 Blaze Rods in the corners, 4 Blaze Powder in the remaining outer edges, and 1 Glass Bottle  in the center slot 

64x Firework Rockets (Flight Duration 1): Crafted cleanly using 1 Gold Ingot, 1 Gunpowder, and 1 Paper to instantly give you a full stack of 64 FD1 rockets to support your Elytra or Trident traveling.

Created for Minecraft 1.21.х. Drop the data pack folder into your world/datapacks directory, type /reload, and rule the server!
